# Ayodeji Eluwande

> Product manager and builder with 5+ years shipping products across FinTech, HRTech, EdTech, and marketplace platforms. Based in Berlin, Germany, from Lagos, Nigeria. Manages products and builds them too, shipping production platforms with Next.js, React, and AI tooling.

Key facts:

- Product Lead, Strategy and Operations at Skilladder AI. Built the assessment platform from zero, grew it to 6 recurring enterprise clients, served a national talent cohort of 85,000+ candidates, and cut deployment time by 85%.
- Previously Product Manager at Tellerpoint (agency banking, including UnionDirect for Union Bank of Nigeria), Devlabs Africa, and Switch Recycling.
- Has built and shipped 13 sites and apps, including WhatsApp-native commerce tools, a cohort-based LMS, a logistics platform, and client sites.
- Stack: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL, Supabase. AI tools: Cursor, Claude Code, Lovable, Replit.
- Education: Bachelor of Laws (LL.B), Lagos State University.
